svg.title: Corner window arch and central H25 bar
svg.desc: Upper window elevation shows the partial arch bar, straight tangent and two clashes with the previous pier cage. Adjacent plot shows maximum bending interaction at 19 discrete stations, before and after adding the bar.
svg.text: 180 × 215 mm inner RC arch · South elevation · Occupied concrete face at Y 402.5 mm
640 mm near tangent. Crosses two H20 bars in the previous pier cage.
The new bar carries bending at stations 0 and 1 in this calculation.
Lower window and pier omitted below Z 5400 mm.
Station from near spring to far spring
Peak 1.189 → 0.992. Dashed line marks the 1.000 limit.
Each point is a sampled member end. Intermediate extrema remain open.
